# mooncake mod verify

Re-hash every locked module and report drift

## Description

Re-hashes each module pinned in mooncake.modules.lock from the
local cache and compares it against the pin. Never clones: a module that is not
cached is reported as missing, not fetched.

Exits non-zero if any module is not ok.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--playbook` | string | - | Path to the mooncake.yml to read (default: ./mooncake.yml) |
| `--format / -f` | string | `text` | Output format: text or json |
